Hero.Name: Berserker
Hero.Description: The Berserker likes to resolve conflicts... with his HAMMER! If you're close enough to see the whites of his eyes, it's too late - you're going to need a good doctor.
Hero.StoreDescription: Uses Axes, Hammers, & Throwing Weapons. Includes 5 slots of storage!

Hero.Name: Ranger
Hero.Description: Definitely not one of Santa's elves. In fact, don't call her an elf at all. The last guy who tried, she shot full of arrows and then fed him to her pet wolf.

Hero.Name: Sorcerer
Hero.Description: Commanding the power of lightning, the Sorcerer fries his foes with blasts of electricity. When his Volt Shield is up, enemies can't reach him without getting a nasty jolt.

Hero.Name: Battle Chef
Hero.Description: Soup is SO on! This Chef uses only the freshest ingredients... taken straight from the foes he slays! Come and get it! The Chef always makes enough food for everyone!

Hero.Name: Vampire Hunter
Hero.Description: Certainly not daddy's little girl. She will steal your heart... and then drive a stake through it! Setting up traps and playing games of cat-and-mouse are the Vampire Hunter's specialty!

Hero.Name: Ghost Samurai
Hero.Description: Death before dishonor (literally)! The Ghost Samurai wanders the earth seeking vengeance on his killer. An expert swordsman, few can withstand his phantom katana technique.

Hero.Name: Pyromancer
Hero.Description: The Pyromancer is a madman with incredibly powerful fire magic. When his demon form appears, fiery destruction is soon to follow. Just don't get on his bad side!
Hero.StoreDescription: Uses Runes, Gloves, Staves, & Flame Orbs.

Hero.Name: Dragon Knight
Hero.Description: The Dragon Knight once led the vanguard of a lost army of Dragon Riders. With her arsenal of spears, poleaxes and dragon artifacts, baddies will have a hard time keeping up!
